narr: A thunderstorm produce heavy rain over the Paria River drainage and caused flash flooding near Lees Ferry. Another thunderstorm caused flash flooding in Twin Arrows in the evening.
ev: Heavy rain over the Paria River drainage (in Arizona and Utah) caused the river gauge at Lees Ferry to rise 2.5 feet.
Major portions of the Twin Arrows Casino were flooded. Flood debris went all over their roads.
lsr: GAUGE AT LEES FERRY (PLFA3) REGISTERED 2.5 FT RISE.
TWIN ARROWS DIRECTOR OF SECURITY REPORTED THAT MAJOR PORTIONS OF THE PROPERTY WERE FLOODED AND THAT FLOOD WATERS SENT DEBRIS ALL OVER THE ROADS.
